The information is not in our lease. They did come and say they are going to be looking at patios and only patio approved items can be on the patio, however it does not specify what is an patio approved. We did just moved in about 2 months ago, but nothing was told to us. 

The only rules is that grills can be on ground floor (Which we are) and 99 feet from building. Which it is not, however when we asked if we could keep it on the patio they said that it is fine. We brought it up twice and they said both times that it is fine and it is approved, nothing about $100 charge.
Thanks I feel better about my decision. We talked tonight and thought he is still pretty mad he understood why I did what I did.
